target: female Japanese-anime VRM 1.0 VTuber for webcam tracking

reference.source_note: Existing original project concept; historical concept approval recorded in brief, but original explicit approval message is not linked in available files.
reference.fidelity_policy: Preserve visible design signatures, interpret hidden 3D construction transparently; never claim 1:1 physical match from one art image.

must_preserve: Soft feminine anime face, delicate chin, subtle blush and gentle micro-smile
Honey-brown layered fringe and low side ponytail over character right shoulder (viewer left in the source front concept)
Large burgundy silk hair bow at the ponytail anchor, gathered knot and flowing tails
Amber-gold eyes with sunset depth and star/crescent catchlights
Cream-white inner robe, burgundy crossed kimono/haori collar and thin gold trim; preserve layered robe identity
Eight-point gold astral star pendant at collar hollow on a delicate chain
current_visual_defects_observed: Flat thick burgundy strips instead of constructed garment collar and front panels
Cream sleeves and shoulders lack garment volume/draping and seam logic
Rear hairstyle reads as large flat curtain with abrupt cut ends
Hair scalp gap or dark exposed cap visible in side/back views
Detail geometry grew sharply without equivalent silhouette improvement

rig_and_tracking_invariants.avatar_bangs_affect: visual expression readability and collisions, not MediaPipe recognition of the human webcam feed

protected: Face mesh and every facial morph
existing armature/rest hierarchy and neutral pose
